```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gsm.vizr)
```

## Tabs {.tabset}

### First tab

Text so the second tab starts hidden.

### Second tab

```{r hidden-chart}
bars(
  data.frame(site = c("S1", "S1", "S2"), flag = c("2", "1", "2")),
  bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-tab")
)
```

```{r hidden-facet}
# facetBars builds its own container grid and sizes sub-charts from it, so it
# is the shape most likely to mis-measure while its pane is display:none.
bars_df <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S1", "S2"), 4),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1"), each = 4),
  country = rep(c("USA", "CAN"), each = 4)
)
facet_bars(bars_df, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  facet_spec("country", nCol = 2),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-tab-facet")
)
```

```{r hidden-dynamic}
# dynamicSizing derives height from category count at render time, when the
# pane has no dimensions to derive from.
bars(
  data.frame(site = c("S1", "S2", "S3"), n = c(4, 2, 6)),
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", orientation = "horizontal",
    theme = list(dynamicSizing = TRUE)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-tab-dynamic")
)
```
